fields.h1: Build a Spa Booking Form That Plans the Whole Visit
fields.hero_description: Build a spa booking form that books each treatment with a free room and therapist, then saves the visit to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What a Spa Day Needs Before the First Treatment
fields.features_subheading: A spa booking form fits the treatment a guest picks into a free room and a therapist's day, and keeps a record of every visit.
fields.feature_1:
Treatments booked by their real length

List each treatment with its minutes, such as a 60-minute facial or a 90-minute hot stone massage. The form blocks out that length, so a long treatment never lands in a short gap.
fields.feature_2:
A room and a therapist for every time

Tell the form which rooms suit each treatment and which therapists perform it. A time appears only when both are free, so the wrap room and facial room fill on their own schedules.
fields.feature_3:
A named therapist or first available

Guests pick a therapist by name or choose first available. A named request shows only that therapist's open times, and the choice is saved with the visit for the front desk to see.
fields.feature_4:
Confirmations and reminders by email

Each guest gets an email listing the treatments and start times, then a reminder the day before. The front desk gets an alert for any booking made less than 24 hours ahead.
fields.feature_5:
Every booking in a table you own

Bookings save to a database you own, with no cap on how many the form takes. Filter a day to plan staffing, or connect the table to your point-of-sale system through its API.
fields.feature_6:
Code you can take with you

On paid plans, export the full codebase to your GitHub repository. Host the spa booking form on your own servers and keep building on it next to the website you already run.

fields.usecase_heading: The Rule Each Spa Books By
fields.tab_content_1:
The wrap starts at 2:15, after the facial and a reset

Delia Brennert wants a facial and a body wrap on the same afternoon at Brinestone Day Spa. She picks the 60-minute hydrating facial at 1:00 and the 50-minute seaweed body wrap. Brinestone leaves 15 minutes of turnover between treatments. The form starts her wrap at 2:15. Her confirmation email lists both times.
fields.tab_content_2:
Two therapists free, or no couples time

Each couples massage at Larchwood Spa needs the couples suite and 2 therapists at once. On Saturday at 2:00 the suite is open, but only 1 therapist is free. The form hides that time, and 6:30 too, since the suite is booked. Aurelio and Margarethe Tresidder book 3:30, and the suite and 2 therapists are held for them.
fields.tab_content_3:
Benedetta gets every bridal party of 5 or more

Lisette Galbraith is getting married and books a Saturday morning at Willowmere Spa for her bridal party of 6. She lists 3 guests for express facials and 3 for manicures. Willowmere sends any party of 5 or more to Benedetta Wolcott, its events coordinator, by email, and she sets up the rooms for the morning.
fields.tab_content_4:
No more Saturday passes after the 30th

Brookhollow Bathhouse caps day passes for its pools and sauna at 30 a day. By Friday night, 28 Saturday passes are sold. Ansel Thornbury books the last 2 from his phone, and Saturday now shows as sold out. The next guest who opens the form is offered Sunday instead.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Spa Booking Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to plan a spa booking form around your treatment menu and rooms, then build it in Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 List every treatment and its length
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Ask only what the front desk uses
fields.howto_step_1_des: List each treatment on your menu with its minutes and price, such as an 80-minute deep tissue massage or a 30-minute express facial. The form books by those lengths. Time a few real sessions and use those numbers.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Give each room the treatments it can host and each therapist the treatments they perform. A wet room might take wraps and scrubs only. Those two lists decide which start times the form can offer a guest.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Decide how many minutes a room needs between guests for fresh linens and a reset. Enter that number once, and the form adds it after every treatment. Use a time that holds on a full Saturday.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Ask for the treatment, the date and start time, a therapist preference, and the guest's name, email, and phone. Add a notes box for requests such as a quieter room. Leave out any question nobody on staff reads.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Pick one person for large parties
fields.howto_step_5_des: Choose who handles parties of 5 or more and any booking that needs the couples suite. The form emails that person the full booking with each guest's treatment. Rooms get planned before any guest arrives.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Put everything from the first five steps into one prompt. Emergent builds the spa booking form and the database it saves to. To change a price or add a therapist later, describe the change in a sentence.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Test a full day, then publish
fields.howto_step_7_des: Book a busy Saturday against the form yourself: two treatments back to back and a party of 6. Confirm each hidden time should be hidden, then publish the form on the website where guests already book.

faq_plan.q: What is a spa booking form?
faq_plan.a: A spa booking form is the online form a day spa or bathhouse uses to take bookings for treatments. A guest picks a treatment, a date and start time, and sometimes a therapist, and the form saves the booking with the guest's contact details.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a spa booking form?
faq_plan.a: Start with your treatment menu and each treatment's length, then note which rooms and therapists each one needs. Describe both in a prompt to Emergent's AI form builder. It builds the form, the rules for open times, and a database for the bookings, and you ask for changes the same way.

faq_plan.q: What questions should a spa booking form ask guests?
faq_plan.a: Ask only what decides the booking and how to reach the guest: the treatment, the time, and contact details. Add a therapist preference if guests request people by name. Keep health questions on a separate intake form. A form Emergent builds stores its bookings in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: Can hotel guests use a spa booking form that knows their stay dates?
faq_plan.a: Yes, if both live in one app. A hotel booking form takes nights and a room type, and the spa part adds a treatment and a start time. Ask for the stay dates first, then offer treatments only on the days the guest is staying.

faq_plan.q: How does a spa booking form avoid double-booking a treatment room?
faq_plan.a: It offers a start time only when the room and a therapist who performs that treatment are free for its full length plus the turnover gap. Once a guest books, that room and therapist drop out of the times the next guest sees.

faq_plan.q: How should a spa booking form handle couples treatments?
faq_plan.a: Book it as one reservation: the couples suite plus 2 therapists who start together. Hide any time where either one is missing. Ask for both guests' names and their treatments, and show each therapist which guest is theirs.

faq_plan.q: Why use a spa booking form instead of a generic scheduler?
faq_plan.a: Because a spa books rooms and therapists, not only time. A general booking form holds one slot for one service. A spa form offers a time only when a free room and a qualified therapist are both open for the whole treatment.

faq_plan.q: Should a spa booking form include a cancellation policy?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Show your policy above the submit button with a required checkbox, such as 24 hours' notice to cancel, and save the time the guest agreed. Repeat the policy in the confirmation email. The guest then has it in writing.

faq_plan.q: How do I limit day passes on a spa booking form?
faq_plan.a: Set a daily limit, and have the form count the passes sold for each date. When the count reaches the limit, that date shows as sold out and the form offers the next open day. Emergent builds the form and the count from a plain-English prompt.

faq_plan.q: Can a spa booking form take bridal party and group bookings?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Ask the person booking for the party size and each guest's treatment, and email any party above a size you choose to one coordinator. For a full spa buyout or a private event that holds the whole date, an event booking form fits better.
